wording_corrections.old: Recall Authentication and authorisation. Explain why a recorded result needs its input conditions and evidence source before it can support a claim.
wording_corrections.new: Recall Agents and Tools: a valid state transition does not itself authorise an operation. This week, check who may do what to which resource before execution.

wording_corrections.old: Map actions by consequence, grant minimum permissions, add adult gates, test a denied request, and verify the workflow stops safely.
wording_corrections.new: Audit the five supplied catalogue proposals under read R2/R5 only, then draw a fictional draft→adult review→permitted-action gate. Check exact content and destination. All decisions are paper simulations; do not execute messages, edits or purchases.

wording_corrections.old: Map actions by consequence, grant minimum permissions, add adult gates, test a denied request, and verify the workflow stops safely.
wording_corrections.new: Audit the five supplied catalogue proposals under read R2/R5 only, then draw a fictional draft→adult review→permitted-action gate. Check exact content and destination. All decisions are paper simulations; do not execute messages, edits or purchases.

wording_corrections.old: Keep for an independent attempt: A teacher allows a tool to draft a message but forbids sending. The draft is correct. May the agent send it? Explain the boundary.
wording_corrections.new: Use the earlier transfer question as optional practice. Reserve Decide inventory calls independently for the first independent attempt before hints or feedback.

wording_corrections.old: Use the concrete case as the shared normal case and the independent question as a second case. Each pair creates a boundary or missing-information case and predicts its result before testing. Keep the expected result separate from an observed mistake.
wording_corrections.new: Use the supplied main investigation for shared practice. Reserve Decide inventory calls independently for the individual first attempt. The named extension has separate tasks and feedback.

wording_corrections.old: Complete this page without copying the worked example. Your reasoning matters more than decoration.
wording_corrections.new: Use after practice. Decide inventory calls independently is the selected independent task.

wording_corrections.old: CHALLENGE  Place approval gates in a field-trip planning workflow.
wording_corrections.new: Require the permitted operation and object for each call; a generated plan cannot expand authority.

wording_corrections.old: Individual check: For Privacy and least privilege, use its worked case to evaluate this proposed explanation: “A successful run proves the conclusion”. Explain the deciding step.
wording_corrections.new: Individual check: The toy role-policy function returns True for a permitted read. Does that establish that every collected field is necessary and can be retained indefinitely? Explain what else must be decided.

wording_corrections.old: Expected correction: Retention must be tied to a purpose and school policy rather than a guessed universal number of days. Identify who can correct or delete records and avoid keeping raw responses indefinitely just because storage is available.
wording_corrections.new: Expected correction: No. A permission-table result does not justify unnecessary fields, authenticate the caller or specify retention. Choose fields for the stated purpose, use an approved retention/deletion process and name the responsible owner.

wording_corrections.old: Next connection: Testing pure components. Preserve the current case record and retrieve its evidence boundary before moving on.
wording_corrections.new: Next is Week32: Project Problem and Success Test. Carry forward exact task scope, source checks and human decision boundaries when defining project success.
